import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """year,mangrove_ha,gmw_2020_baseline_ha,holdout_accuracy_2020
2017,13935,7510.9,0.96011
2018,11135,7510.9,0.96011
2019,9714.1,7510.9,0.96011
2020,12029,7510.9,0.96011
2021,12087,7510.9,0.96011
2022,14194,7510.9,0.96011
2023,10741,7510.9,0.96011
2024,11913,7510.9,0.96011
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_area(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.0, 3.4))
    ax.bar(df.year, df.mangrove_ha, color="#00a884", label="mangrove, this model")
    ax.plot(df.year, df.gmw_2020_baseline_ha, color="#1f2933", lw=2, ls="--",
            label="GMW 2020 baseline")
    lo = min(df.mangrove_ha.min(), df.gmw_2020_baseline_ha.min())
    ax.set_ylim(lo * 0.9, None)
    ax.set_ylabel("Area (ha)")
    ax.set_title("Mangrove area vs. the GMW 2020 baseline, Segara Anakan", loc="left",
                 fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_area(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """Dynamic World 2024,ha,share
trees,1126.7,0.42182
flooded vegetation,785.76,0.29419
water,314.52,0.11776
crops,242.21,0.090685
built,108.85,0.040755
shrub and scrub,61.127,0.022886
grass,31.456,0.011777
bare,0.32494,0.00012166
snow,0,0
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_after(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2, 3.6))
    cols = {"water": "#419bdf", "trees": "#397d49", "grass": "#88b053",
            "flooded vegetation": "#7a87c6", "crops": "#e49635", "shrub and scrub": "#dfc35a",
            "built": "#c4281b", "bare": "#a59b8f", "snow": "#b39fe1"}
    ax.pie(df.ha, labels=df["Dynamic World 2024"], colors=[cols[n] for n in df["Dynamic World 2024"]],
           autopct="%1.0f%%", textprops={"fontsize": 8})
    ax.set_title("What the lost mangrove is now", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    return fig

plot_after(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """class,B11,B12,B2,B3,B4,B5,B8
mangrove,0.12596,0.05517,0.029763,0.055161,0.030743,0.095235,0.3066
open water,0.020484,0.016584,0.052708,0.064531,0.040997,0.037082,0.022435
other trees,0.17481,0.079095,0.03021,0.057582,0.030197,0.098644,0.3457
crops and ponds edge,0.18649,0.10836,0.051261,0.079594,0.074687,0.12797,0.24408
built,0.2383,0.1836,0.06837,0.091761,0.099579,0.14258,0.24413
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_signature(df):
    wl = [490, 560, 665, 705, 842, 1610, 2190]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.6, 3.4))
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        ax.plot(wl, [r[b] for b in ["B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B8", "B11", "B12"]], marker="o",
                label=r["class"])
    ax.set_xlabel("Wavelength (nm)"); ax.set_ylabel("Surface reflectance (median)")
    ax.set_title("Spectral signatures by class, 2024", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_signature(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """trees,holdout_accuracy
10,0.93447
25,0.94872
50,0.94872
100,0.96296
150,0.96011
250,0.96011
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_tuning(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.6, 3.0))
    ax.plot(df.trees, df.holdout_accuracy, marker="o", color="#2a78d6")
    ax.set_xlabel("Number of trees"); ax.set_ylabel("Hold-out accuracy")
    ax.set_title("Random forest tuning", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    return fig

plot_tuning(df)
plt.show()
